raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Tai Si was the paternal grandmother of King Kang of Zhou, conflating Tai Si (King Wen’s queen and mother of King Wu) with the mother of King Cheng (who is Yi Jiang). This misapplied the genealogical chain (King Kang → King Cheng → Cheng’s mother) and prematurely instructed returning “Tai Si” despite evidence pointing to Yi Jiang, relying on a questionable SERP snippet instead of corroborating authoritative sources.
